extended:
**THE HOLONOMY BRAIDING FORUξ(sl2) IN TERMS OF GEOMETRIC QUANTUM DILOGARITHMS**

*CALVIN MCPHAIL-SNYDER AND NICOLAI RESHETIKHIN*

41 pp, 16 sections.

**Abstract.** We derive an explicit formula for the holonomyR-matrix of quantumsl2 at a root of unity. We show it factorizes into a product of four quantum dilogarithms and satisfies a holonomy Yang-Baxter equation. This factorization extends previously known results and we collect many existing results needed for our computation.

**Outline.** 1 Introduction; 2 Quantum sl2 and Weyl algebras; 2.3 Representation into the Weyl algebra; 3 Specialization to a root of unity; 3.1 Central subalgebras at roots of unity; 3.2 Uξ-modules.; 3.3 The braiding on characters; 3.6 Wξ-modules; 4.4 The holonomy Yang-Baxter equation; 5 R-matrix computations; 5.1 Log-parameter dependence; Appendix A. Quantum dilogarithms; A.1. Basic definitions; A.2. Fusion identities; A.3. Fourier transform identities; References
